# S3.4b — the Stage-3 results store (`hh-results`): `ResultsRow/1` + `project_row`, immutable row versions under fixed-key heads, `build_cells`, watermark-aware reads, the bundle catalogue + `bundle_refs`, `verify_row`/`verify_citation`, and the lab-internal `leaderboard()` with L1–L5 (R-2.10.5⁰)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §6.5 (results store) · §2.2 (watermarks,
verify) · §8 (reproducibility)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/048_S3.4b__results-store.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.10.5⁰**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s3.4a` (stacked) · **Stage:** 3 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only (all checks hermetic)
**ADR:** `docs/adr/ADR-0279-s3.4b-results-store-rulings.md`

## Summary

**The store is a projection layer — the ledger stays authoritative.**
`ResultsRow/1` carries the run's coordinates
(`configuration_version_id`/`arm_id`/`task_id`/`replicate_no`/`split_label`),
its `ExperimentBinding`, `RunOutcome`, per-metric cells, consumption,
cache usage, lineage, annotations, the audit head + completeness flag,
the pinned scoring context, `derived_from`, the watermark set, and a
view hash. The fixed key is `(configuration_version_id, run_id)`; the
row version id is the IDP content address of the canonical bytes.
Metric values, scoring context, annotations and bundle refs live in
versions or derived views — never in the key.

**`project_row` is pure and re-scoring is immutable.** Projection folds
the durable prefix, overlay runs, and the pinned
`ScoringContext{metric_registry_version}` into row bytes — deterministic
under the same prefix. `rescore` lands a **new** version with
`supersedes` + `derived_from_reason{regrade|import|refresh}`; `head(key)`
moves, `row_history` orders the lineage, and old version bytes are
untouched. No qualifying bundle ⇒ `rescore` refuses; overlay runs that
don't target the run refuse `OverlayNotTargeting`.

**Reads are watermark-aware and never leak ahead.** `get_row`,
`query_rows` (typed factor filters — `arm_id`, `configuration_version_id`,
`task_id`, `split_label`, `outcome_class`, `experiment_run_id`,
`cell_na:<metric>` — plus `UnknownField`/`UnknownCursor` refusals and
cursor pagination), `cells()`/`build_cells`, and `distribution()` all run
at a `WatermarkSet`. An `at`-pinned read serves the newest covered
*version*, not the head; pins beyond the durable head or on unknown runs
refuse `WatermarkAhead`; repeats return an equal `view_hash`.
`rebuild_all` into a fresh store reproduces every `version_id` and row
byte (AC-1).

**Cells are per-attempt, per-metric, and everything cites.**
`build_cells` produces the `(task_id, metric_id)` table with `{values,
n}` folds and every attempt row — excluded attempts carry their reason.
Class-scoped rendering is explicit: a hosted `events`-only run renders
`n/a{class}` for native-only metrics and `n/a{observability}` for
end-state metrics — absence is never a silent 0. **Every cell, `n/a`
included, cites ≥1 `AuditRef` that verifies** (AC-12); blob redaction
flips a citation to `Missing{redacted}`, never drops the row.
`verify_row` re-projects and recomputes the true id — a forged
`version_id` in stored bytes fails the integrity report.

**The catalogue is derived, never authoritative.** `refresh` scans
`bundle_assembled` events, resolves manifests by recomputing each pool
object's bundle id (ADR-0279 D1), validates members via
`check_completeness` (the S1/S2/S4/S7 subset — ADR-0279 D2), and stores
derived entries with `bundle_id`, kind, subject runs, configuration ids,
experiment run id, `claimed_level`, `max_supported_level`, status,
readers, name bindings, bytes, `created_at`, producer,
`manifest_available`, and `level_now` — recomputed from live pool
contents so GC/redaction degrades it without deleting the entry.
`annotate` lands `bundle_refs` on head versions as derived annotations —
row bytes never mutate.

**`leaderboard()` is lab-internal and gated L1–L5.** L1 bundle admission:
a covering bundle must meet `min_status` (default `validated`) **and**
the optional `min_claimed_level` — the *declared* reproducibility claim,
not `level_now`, per ADR-0279 D4. L2 eligibility: included + finished +
not superseded/excluded, metric applies to the row's participant class
and observability level, concrete value. L3: stratum = `MatchSpec` idp —
ranks never cross strata; arms without a usable spec are
`unmatched_budget` exclusions (defensive — the engine refuses un-matched
arms at declaration). L4: metric direction orders, ties break on
`finished_at` then fixed row key, dense ranks per stratum. L5:
`ExperimentBinding.comparable = false` reports as an exclusion, never a
rank. The engine's E-4 close records land as entry flags —
`budget_imbalanced`, `under_utilised` — never exclusions. No rank ever
admits a score without a validated bundle (AC-3).

**Ledger fix (additive).** `commit_envelopes` re-chains `prev_hash` after
HLC stamping — stamping changed event hashes without updating intra-batch
links, which `verify_run` surfaced as stored `Tampered{chain_broken}` on
lineage-bearing runs. Plus additive accessors `run_ids`, `blob_digests`,
`blob_status` (pub) for citation verification — no contract changes.

## Verification

- `cargo test --workspace` — all green (144+ result lines, 0 failures;
  `hh-results` integration 14/14).
- `cargo fmt -p hh-results -p hh-ledger -- --check` — clean (workspace-wide
  `fmt --check` shows pre-existing rustfmt-version skew in untouched
  crates; not churned here).
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` — clean.
- `scripts/check-drift.sh` — generated artifacts in sync.
- `scripts/check-removability.sh` — clean (tiers 0–3).
- `check-build-memory.sh .` — 0 violations (1 pre-existing BM-ADR-04
  warning, verified unchanged with the ADR stashed).

## Evidence highlights

- `hh-results` — 14 integration tests over a real `Store` + `LabDocs` +
  `ExperimentEngine` rig: deterministic projection + typed refusals,
  codec/id recomputation, version supersession + head moves, `at`-read
  repeatability + `WatermarkAhead`, per-cell citation verification +
  `Missing{redacted}`, `verify_row` tamper detection, the cell table with
  exclusion reasons, the AC-3 catalogue arm (no-bundle/`assembled`/
  `validated` R0/`validated` R1 → `min_claimed_level` admits one),
  L5 comparability exclusions, `rebuild_all` byte-reproduction,
  factor filters + cursor pagination + distributions, class-scoped
  `n/a` cells, and `imbalanced`/`under_utilised` flags that never
  exclude.
- `hh-ledger` — HLC re-chain fix keeps `verify_run` clean on
  lineage-bearing runs.

## Deferrals / deviations

- Hosted-leaderboard arms (cross-class rank refusal over real hosted
  rows) are unreachable at Stage 3 — the L2 applicability gate is the
  compensating control; executable coverage lands with the hosted tiers.
- `rescore`'s `RevokedValidator` mode, `subscribe`, `export_rows`,
  `snapshots`/`diff_snapshots`, L6–L9, `publish` — Stage-4 item scope
  (manifest C1 row).
- Progress notes appended to DF-S1.24-1 / DF-S1.24-2; no rows closed,
  none opened.
